content: In this section we introduce our proposed hierarchical model taking into account the data structure. We outline that the decoding component aiming to generate descriptions is considered as a black-box module so that our contribution is focused on the encoding module. We first describe the model overview, before detailing the hierarchical encoder and the associated hierarchical attention.
